doc:
### PROPOSAL-04 — Painterly / Watercolor - **slug**: `painterly-watercolor` - **Vibe**: Soft layered washes, translucent color, and warm paper — the UI looks hand-painted rather than rendered. - **Best for**: Onboarding flows, product show pages, and campaign storytelling. Adjectives: calm, handcrafted, warm. - **Palette** (light theme, `is_dark: false`): | Token | Value | Usage | |---|---|---| | `--bg-canvas` | `#f4ead8` | Warm paper canvas with wash overlay | | `--bg-surface` | `#fdf8ef` | Card paper fill | | `--bg-surface-elevated` | `#fffcf4` | Raised/hovered paper | | `--border-subtle` | `#e6d9c0` | Soft wash hairlines | | `--border-default` | `#cdbfa3` | Standard soft borders | | `--border-focus` | `#9a6234` | Burnt-sienna brush focus | | `--text-primary` | `#3b2f26` | Warm dark ink-brown headings | | `--text-secondary` | `#5c4f42` | Body text | | `--text-muted` | `#7a6a58` | Captions, dates, helper text | | `--color-action` | `#9a6234` | Burnt-sienna primary action | | `--color-action-hover` | `#7f5127` | Action hover (deeper sienna) | | `--color-earnings` | `#4f7d4f` | Sage-green wash for earnings | | `--color-earnings-hover` | `#3f6a40` | Earnings hover (deeper sage) | | `--color-automation` | `#5a7f9e` | Dusty-blue automation wash | | `--color-alert` | `#c9922e` | Ochre warnings | | `--color-danger` | `#a6534f` | Muted vermilion destructive states | | `--color-action-glow` | `rgba(154, 98, 52, 0.12)` | Translucent wash behind action icons | | `--color-earnings-glow` | `rgba(79, 125, 79, 0.12)` | Translucent wash behind earnings icons | | `--color-automation-glow` | `rgba(90, 127, 158, 0.12)` | Translucent wash behind automation icons | - **Typography**: Display: `"Fraunces", Georgia, serif` at 500-600 weight, soft optical sizing, no extra tracking. Sans: `"Lora", Georgia, serif` (warm, readable). Mono: `"IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, monospace` reserved for timestamps and IDs so data reads "typeset". Numerals `tabular-nums`. - **Radii & Borders**: Organic and irregular: cards use asymmetric radii (e.g., `1rem 1rem 1rem 0.25rem`), buttons are soft pills. 1px borders only, in muted tones. Shadows are very soft (`0 12px 40px rgba(80, 60, 40, 0.10)`). - **Component Patterns**: - **Buttons**: Soft pills with a translucent wash fill and a 1px border in a deeper tone of the same hue; white/ink text depending on wash depth. Hover deepens the wash opacity. Focus = soft double border (2px sienna ring with gap). - **Cards**: Paper-white with a soft shadow and a layered translucent accent wash in one corner (radial-gradient, low opacity). Optional deckled edge via asymmetric radii. No hard outlines. - **Badges/Status**: Translucent pills with a soft dot; no hard borders — status reads as colored water on paper. Publishing = slowly breathing dot. - **Tables**: Minimal rules; generous row padding; header labels in small-caps serif. Row hover = soft wash band rather than a hard highlight. - **Forms/Inputs**: Underline-only fields with placeholder in italic serif; focus = sienna brush underline that fades in. Errors in muted vermilion below the field. - **Loading**: Three soft ink dots that "bloom" (opacity + scale) in sequence; determinate progress = a gentle wash filling a rounded track. - **Signature detail**: The layered translucent wash gradient on the canvas plus hand-drawn underline accents on headings — watercolor bleed, no hard edges. - **Motion & Animation**: Slow and liquid — 300-450ms ease-in-out; elements fade in with a 6px upward drift and slight blur-to-sharp. Turbo Stream additions "bleed" in rather than pop. - **Signature Preview Snippet**: ```html
Campaign

Summer Launch — Soundcore Q45

3 posts scheduled
```
